# Hallmarc National Fitouts

> Hallmarc National Fitouts is a turnkey fitout and project management company delivering retail, commercial and hospitality projects across Australia. Founded in 2016 by Marcus Hall, Hallmarc is senior-led (a single point of contact, not handed to juniors), manufactures joinery in-house, and is licensed across Australia. Tagline: "Spaces built to be remembered."

## About
Hallmarc National Fitouts delivers fitout projects from concept through to completion — design coordination, procurement, joinery, trades, compliance and handover. Founded 2016 by Marcus Hall (trade-qualified cabinet maker and shopfitter). Head office: Arundel, Gold Coast, QLD. Cm3 certified with a record of zero site safety incidents.

Key differentiators:
- In-house joinery manufacturing (quality control and speed) plus a vetted national fabricator network for scale.
- Senior-led project management — one accountable point of contact on every project.
- National delivery, licensed across Australia (VIC, QLD, SA, ACT, WA); Tasmania available on request.
- Concept-to-completion turnkey delivery.

## Services
- [Retail fitouts](https://www.hallmarcfitouts.com.au/retail): flagship stores, national multi-site rollout programs, brand-compliant shopfitting.
- [Commercial fitouts](https://www.hallmarcfitouts.com.au/commercial): corporate workplaces, developer display suites, base-building, health & medical, education, government and mixed-use.
- [Hospitality fitouts](https://www.hallmarcfitouts.com.au/hospitality): restaurants, pubs, bars, hotels, cafes and QSR, with deep back-of-house technical expertise (commercial kitchens, 3-phase power, exhausts, hydraulics).

## Coverage
Delivering nationally, including Gold Coast, Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne, Adelaide, Perth and Darwin. Licensed across Australia (VIC, QLD, SA, ACT, WA).

## Proof and experience
- Retail clients include Stylerunner, DISSH, City Beach, Honey Birdette, Lovisa, Peter Alexander, Kate Spade, Hugo Boss, Nudie Jeans and Just Group brands.
- Hospitality clients include Zambrero, The Terminus Hotel, The King Hotel, RSL NSW and TAB.
- Commercial: The Eveleigh (Broadbeach) developer display suite, delivered in 4.5 weeks.
- [Project case studies](https://www.hallmarcfitouts.com.au/projects)
